title: Craft Codex
description: Browse every item in the game from a clean sidebar panel, search by name, and click any item to instantly view its crafting recipe — all without leaving your inventory.
body: Craft Codex is a lightweight, recipe viewer Fabric. Browse every item in the game from a clean sidebar panel, search by name, and click any item to instantly view its crafting, smelting, blasting, smoking, stonecutting, or smithing recipe — all without leaving your inventory. No commands needed — all recipes are automatically unlocked on world join.
